title: Poor and Needy
summary: The poor and needy were protected in God’s law and frequently represent those vulnerable to injustice and exploitation.
background: Poverty in Scripture includes hunger, debt, land loss, widowhood, oppression, and vulnerability. God commands generosity and justice toward the needy.
teachingHelp: When a passage mentions the poor, clarify whether it concerns material poverty, oppression, humility, or dependence on God.
